stories.title: Define Provider Detail Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a structured response schema for provider detail including specialty, license, status, address, phone, and enumeration date aligned to NPI Registry output and internal normalization needs.

stories.title: Implement NPI Registry Lookup and Normalization Logic
stories.description: Implement core service logic to call CMS NPI Registry API, extract provider credentials, and normalize fields (specialty, license status, address formatting, contact info, enumeration date).

stories.title: Expose Provider Detail via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate provider detail service into evaluate_care_facade and expose it through the tool routing layer for agent consumption.

stories.title: Provider Detail Lookup Tests (Unit + Integration)
stories.description: Create unit tests for normalization logic and integration tests for end-to-end NPI lookup through the facade ensuring correct field mapping and error handling.

stories.title: Handle NPI Lookup Errors and Incomplete Data
stories.description: Implement error handling and fallback behavior for NPI Registry failures, missing fields, or partial provider records, ensuring graceful degradation and consistent schema output.
